Step 3 (Choose Alertmanager) may not show a dropdown with only the built-in Grafana Alertmanager, so it may be a note. Steps 7 and 8 are optional. Verified 13.2.2: nav Alerting > Notification configuration opens with the "Contact points" tab already selected. No "Choose Alertmanager" dropdown is shown (only the built-in one). The button is a link "New contact point" (aria name "add contact point"). Form: Name *, Integration combobox (pick "Webhook", then a URL field appears), "Optional Webhook settings" and "Notification settings" collapsibles, "Save contact point". Saving a webhook to http://127.0.0.1:9/docdemo succeeded.

title: Create a library panel
notes: Starts on the seeded, non-provisioned 'DocDemo Sandbox' dashboard (one TestData panel 'Sandbox traffic'); provisioned dashboards (CPU overview, Request latency) cannot be saved from the UI, so do not use them. Step 2 needs a hover to reveal the panel menu. Verified 13.2.2 end to end on the sandbox: the "Edit" button's accessible name is "Enter edit mode"; after hovering the panel, button "Menu for panel Sandbox traffic" appears; menu item "More..." opens a submenu on hover with "New library panel"; dialog has "Library panel name" (prefilled "Sandbox traffic"), a "Save in folder" picker and "Create library panel". Toolbar Save opens a "Save dashboard" drawer with a Message box and Save; afterwards "Exit edit" remains. The library element was created and the dashboard saved.

title: Add a custom variable
notes: Step 1 is a link to another section ('Enter general options for any variable': Edit, Add new element > Variable, choose Custom, Name) that the fragment does not include; the run must perform it without those steps being quoted. Use the seeded 'DocDemo Sandbox' dashboard (saveable). CSV values such as 'dev,staging,prod'. Verified 13.2.2 end to end on the sandbox: in edit mode there is an "Add variable" button above the panels (and an "Add" sidebar with a "Variable" button); the type list has a "Custom" button; the sidebar shows Name (default custom0), Label, Description, Display, and "Open variable editor". The editor dialog has CSV/JSON radios, a values textbox, a live "Preview of values (N)" list, and Discard/Apply. There is no Preview button, so step 4 is a real mismatch. Save + Save in the drawer persisted the variable.

notes: 18 steps with branches ('go to step 12'), a reference-only step 11 and Enterprise-only saved queries. TestData is the default data source (random walk), so no query needs writing; step 6 can be satisfied by the default TestData scenario. No generative AI is configured. Verified 13.2.2: Dashboards > New > "New dashboard" opens /dashboard/new with the Add sidebar already expanded; its "Panel" button adds a panel offering "Configure visualization" and "Use library panel" (no "Use saved query" in OSS).
